video_metadata.title: Progressing The BLOODREND VAMPIRE Build (1-20) | Deepwoken

build_summary.creator_opinion: A high-sustain, high-damage vampire-themed build utilizing the Starkindred Oath wings and Bloodrend attunement. It relies on heavy weapon criticals, bleed effects, and life drain while maintaining high mobility in PvP combat.
strengths: High health regeneration and lifesteal via Bloodrend mantras
Excellent mobility and air control using Starkindred wings
Strong posture damage and heavy weapon burst potential
Optimized stat distribution using Shrine of Order
weaknesses: Requires precise execution of Shrine of Order stat allocation
Reliant on maintaining tempo and landing Bloodrend skills
Susceptible to heavy parry punish if attacks are mis-timed

shrine_of_order.pre_shrine_goals: Reach 40 Strength, 40 Agility, 40 Fortitude, and 25 Charisma before leveling up heavy weapon and main attunement.
shrine_of_order.post_shrine_progression: Dump remaining points into Heavy Weapon (74) and Bloodrend (61) while maxing Fortitude to 50 for durability.

combo_and_playstyle.playstyle: Aggressive aerial pressure and bleed-stacking melee combat.
key_combos: Starkindred Aerial Engage -> Heavy M1 / Critical -> Crucifixion -> Blood Orb
Bloodtide Ritual -> Move Stack / Mix-up -> Heavy M1 Back-shot
combo_and_playstyle.pvp_tips: Use Starkindred wings to re-position and glide over AoE attacks. Apply pressure with heavy criticals and rely on Bloodrend lifesteal during prolonged exchanges.
